chunks: Hammad narrated from Hariz, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in entering ihram in any garment in which you pray.

key_terms.تُحْرِمَ: you enter the state of ihram
key_terms.ثَوْبٍ: a garment or piece of clothing
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Can a person enter ihram in any garment that is valid for prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about clothing suitable for ihram. It states that any garment valid for salat (prayer) is also permissible to use when entering the state of ihram, indicating a shared standard of permissibility and ritual suitability.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2595 - Hamad narrated from Hariz, from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"There is no harm in wearing any garment while praying."
